Interface RmiServerService

All Superinterfaces:
Remote
All Known Implementing Classes:
VirtualViewRMI
public interface RmiServerService extends Remote
Remote server-side session exposed to one connected RMI client.

The client receives this object from RmiConnectionService.connect(RmiClientService) and stores it inside ServerProxyRMI. From that point on, every client-to-server command goes through this per-client session.

The concrete server-side implementation is VirtualViewRMI. It adapts RMI calls to the same server controller and message-router flow used by the TCP transport. In other words, TCP and RMI differ only in transport mechanics: once a ClientMessage reaches the server-side virtual view, it is routed through the normal server application pipeline.

All methods return void because server responses are not returned directly from the RMI call. The server answers asynchronously by calling the RmiClientService callback that was provided during connection setup.

  • Method Details

    • handleClientMessage

      void handleClientMessage(ClientMessage clientMessage) throws RemoteException
      Sends one application command message from the client to the server.

      The message contains the protocol type and the client-to-server payload. The server-side implementation uses the session associated with this remote object and routes the message through the normal server pipeline.

      Parameters:
      clientMessage - client-to-server command message
      Throws:
      RemoteException - if the remote session cannot receive or process the call at the RMI level

    • pong

      void pong(PongPayload payload) throws RemoteException
      Sends a keep-alive PONG reply from the client to the server.

      This method is separate from handleClientMessage(ClientMessage) because the ping-pong protocol is connection-level infrastructure, not a user command. The server uses it to record that the client is still alive.

      Parameters:
      payload - keep-alive reply payload
      Throws:
      RemoteException - if the remote session cannot receive the PONG

    • closeSession

      void closeSession() throws RemoteException
      Closes the server-side session associated with this client.

      The client calls this during normal shutdown. The server-side implementation disconnects the session from the controller and unexports the remote session object so that it is no longer available through RMI.

      Throws:
      RemoteException - if the remote close call cannot be delivered
